# HEM v0.8.1b5 — Residual heat after sunshine or room-to-room transfer

When sunshine fades or a warmer neighboring room cools, HEM keeps any continuing rise in room temperature unattributed. Temperature-based heater recovery requires fresh independent readings that level off or fall for at least 15 minutes, followed by a new qualifying rise. Repeated polls do not advance the settling time. The unresolved condition and the OFF retry budget survive a Home Assistant restart.

A fresh physical valve-position report can still establish that a valve is open while it reports Off. PID calibration excludes the affected OFF baseline while the watchdog is monitoring residual heat.
